item.title: Amsterdam police reports 1,005 sexual offenses in 2025, youth violence doubles
item.description: Amsterdam police reported a significant rise in sexual offenses and youth involvement in violent crime in 2025, while other serious crimes, including murder and robbery, declined.

item.title: Customs strike to slow arrivals at Schiphol Airport on Tuesday; Long lines likely
item.description: Customs officers will stage a strike at the baggage claim area on Tuesday, which is expected to cause long lines and delays.

item.title: Police break up "chaotic" house party in Utrecht with 100 teens
item.description: Police intervened late Saturday evening at a house party in the Terwijde neighborhood of Utrecht that drew between 90 and 100 youths and caused significant disruption for local residents.

item.title: Haaksbergen to vote on asylum seeker housing ahead of elections
item.description: Residents of Haaksbergen in Overijssel will vote next month in an advisory referendum on the conditions for housing asylum seekers, coinciding with the municipal elections.

item.title: Netherlands still in top 10 least corrupt countries, despite worst score yet
item.description: The Netherlands remains one of the ten least corrupt countries in the world, but has missed opportunities for improvement in the past year, according to Transparency International (TI).

item.title: Fewer new students at Dutch universities; Decrease most visible among internationals
item.description: Dutch universities again enrolled fewer new students this academic year. The number of new bachelor’s students dropped by over 3 percent compared to last year.
